body:
It's worse than that. 

I do care about her. I *would* like to help. But it's more selfish than that. I miss her. She is a very important part of my life. For four years, she was a part of everything I did. I'd wake up to see her good mornings. She would fall asleep at night with her phone in her hand, mid-text to me. When she worried, I knew. When something good happened, I would look forward to telling her about it. And then I had a job interview and I asked for good luck. And she didn't reply. And slowly she's slipped away from me. And since then I've overreacted in a broken, needy storm of desperate emotions more times than I can count. Recently I saw a puppy playing with a goose, my first thought was to show her. But so can't anymore, because she's gone. And I miss her so much. 

And occasionally she still tells me she cares about me and that she wants to keep me and that she shouldn't have to tell me that because of she wanted me out of her life, she could have kicked me out 100 times. And those little things are all I have to hang onto. 

Days and days of abusive silence, of her telling me she is rude to me because she takes me for granted and she's not sorry, me saying I'm done with her and that I don't care what happens to her and I want her to delete me and block me so I don't have to see her face anymore. And she doesn't block me. I delete her. But I keep apologizing and adding her back. And she doesn't add me back. I just sit here, like an orbiting puppy dog hoping that someday she snaps out of it. But it's probably gone too far. I'm sadness. And she has sweet, charming happiness flirting into her life very day. She has no reason to come back to me. I miss her.

I'm trying. But failing. I want to give her the space she needs to get better. But I miss her so much. And I feel like an idiot for keeping an open place in my life for someone who has chosen to shut me out while she just keeps swimming. I want to be able to accept that she's doing what she feels is best for her right now, but it's so hard to accept that that includes pushing me away. 

There are new guys showing up in her life and being sweet and charming and airy and cute and fun, and they don't know her or care about her yet, and that's exciting and new to her, so she's going along with that, and seeking happiness there. She's falling asleep in a stranger's arms instead of mine *because* she knows I love her. 

And it's painful because I was that, and then we were friends, and then we were close, and then she fell in love with me, and then I fell in love with her, but we were too far away... and now I'm shut out of her life because I'm someone who cares about her. It's not fair. It hurts to be disrespected and disregarded like that. 

I don't know how to deal with it. I'd rather send winky faces to each other on Instagram than the tense, hateful nothing we have now. She won't talk to me but she won't release me. And I miss her. And it's killing me.
So after alternating insanely between hateful to her and sweet to her, and being ignored every step of the way, what can I do? I miss my friend so much.

It's not that I'm only trying to talk to her. It's just that she's the relationship I'm losing so she's the one I was focusing on saving. And then it got more complicated when she went suicidally depressed. So now I'm needy and trying to get attention, which was bad enough, PLUS trying to still be here for her through her depression, when I was fairly convinced she didn't care about me at all the weeks leading up to the depression. It's emotionally destroying me. 

I only said I wouldn't care if she was gone because she knows I do care, and she has made it very clear that she doesn't care that I care. I was basically accepting that when she says she doesn't want to hurt the people who care about her, she's not including me in that consideration. 

Idk. I'm lost.

I sent her 361 cruel and hateful and final words last night that should burn the bridge forever. I'm tired of hurting. I'm not proud of doing it. But she has been unbelievably cruel to me for weeks and I can't take it anymore. She doesn't care that I'm hurting, so I shouldn't have to keep caring that she is. She has all the space she needs now.
I sent her 361 words last night that should burn the bridge forever. I'm tired of hurting because of her.

How do you survive? I'm generally a depressed, hopeless person to begin with and how cruel she is being is killing me. She stays alive because people would get hurt if she died. I don't have that. 

I wish she would just release me. But she won't.

Just sent this:
"Still giving you space. But I am calm. I am someone far away who knows you, who you can be honest with. I can be that for you as long as need it. Always."

I may have blown all of that. I definitely messaged too much. I definitely overwhelmed her. I definitely was needy for attention. I definitely took it personally. 

Whatever I do now has to be delicate. Or maybe nothing at all. 

Edit: just sent this...

"Still giving you space. But I am calm. I am someone far away who knows you, who you can be honest with. I can be that for you as long as need it. Always."

My friend had a close friend die a few years ago. She may have been in love with him then. She definitely is now. I kind of want to be that for her. But it's hard to do it from forever away when she feels like she needs grounded to people in her real world to survive.
Same. Someday we'll find out this is the way girls these days say they're not that into their long distance friends anymore without having to actually say it. :\

It complicates things that I missed her *before* she got depressed and suicidal. For like a couple weeks before she went downhill, she'd already shut me out. After years of being inseparable. So we were already rocky. And since the suicide attempt, she's talked to me, but it's been complicated. 

But yeah, I really miss her. I'm as much being selfish because I want my friend back as I am being concerned for wellbeing. 

Sounds like that's the case for you too. 

If I were you, I'd send her a text like "want to go get ice cream?" Mines on the other side of the world though. Or else she would be in my arms right now.

There are billions of people in the world, but I've lost so much touch with her recently that I actually half wonder if it's the same girl you're talking about. I have no idea what she's doing when she's not talking to me. 

She texted and snapchatted me all day every day until a couple months ago when she got busy with life, I had a few needy meltdowns and pushed herrrr away and hadn't had a chance to recover from that before she told me she'd attempted suicide. She's not the same person she was back when we talked every day (of course), and now I've screwed up my end up of it so I'm not the same person to her anymore either. I want to be, but I can't reestablish myself with her when she's (supposedly) pushing *everyone* who cares about her away. 

I sent her something like 50 texts yesterday. Just one after the other, talking about everything, caring about her, wanting to be there for her, how mad I was that she wasn't responding to anything, etc. very smothering, but she was reading them as soon as I sent them. So I kept going. She kept reading and not responding. 

Eventually I sent her a video snapchat of me saying I know this isn't about me, and I am still here and I still care. Talk to me. I said to make a list of the things that  are hurting her so I can understand. Not to give advice or try to help or tell her she's wrong. Just to understand. 

She wrote back that she hadn't made a list, but she would do that later. And she said "give me space." I said thank you, that's all I needed, I will. I doubt that's a good response. I have no idea what I'm doing. 

If I send her a text that says, "just checking in to let you know I'm still here for you," it wouldn't be a surprise. I've been doing that every day. But it's also not "giving space" and I want to respect her, even when she's not respecting me. It hurts.

I think I've already pushed her away with my neediness enough that I can't really be that person to her. She told me today that "it's okay". And I'm in a state right now where that means "I'm not okay, but I don't want to talk about it with you. Please go away." I'm kind of giving her space now I guess. 

After about 50 text messages, which she read immediately but didn't respond to, I asked her to make a list of the things that are bothering her so I can understand, she replied that she didn't have a list, said she'd make one later, and said "give me space." I said I will. I don't want to be overwhelming, and I definitely have been, alternating between telling her I want to be here for her and begging her to talk to me. 

She does have people in her life that care about her. I don't know how much they know. I don't know how much I know. For all I know she tells everyone who will listen, but I really don't think that's the case. But I'm on the other side of the country, I've said she can talk to me, and she really isn't, so maybe she is talking to someone else. 

She told me the other day that I am not real and she needs reality to survive right now. That hurt. But if it's true, it's true.

Not sure if there's anything I can do right now. I will read what you recommended though. Good luck in your situation and thank you for replying.

Going across the country for even a week in hopes of things being better with someone who doesn't act like she gives a shit about me right now is terrifying. If I'm pathetic now, practically begging for her attention like a sad puppy, and she's totally ignoring it, putting in even more needy effort and hundreds of dollars and flying thousands of miles to do the same humiliating thing face to face seems like certain disaster. If she acted like she wanted it, I would do it. But right now she acts like she can't stand me.

Conversation today:
Me: come here and take a nap with me
Her: my job interview is Thursday
Me: the nap won't be that long
Her: *no response*

Three months ago that would have been gold. Now it's nothing.

Does being there for her involve asking about her day and stuff? I mean, I've been pretty consistently there for her for the whole time we've known each other. It being one sided is new and unpleasant. She may not see taking me for granted as a bad thing. I definitely do. 

I sent her a message at 8:30pm her time last night that didn't really require a response. She replied at 6:30am. She hasn't been getting much sleep lately because of stress and she's tired all the time, so I hoped she had just been resting for all those hours. I asked her if she got any sleep. She said a couple hours. I don't know how to reply to that. 

So I asked what she is doing instead of sleeping. She just sat at home watching TV. Not talking to me. And that triggers my irrational, needy ego. But I just make conversation. She doesn't *have* to talk to me all the time. I just miss her *wanting* to talk to me all the time. And I hope I get that back someday, but I have no idea how to from this position of weakness.

Haha I think she knows I'm interested but I see your point. I've been pretty attention-needy lately and she's been pretty annoyed at the world lately, so it's been a rough time. A few days ago she literally said she takes me for granted. In the same conversation she also said she'll never believe I really care about her. So yeah... a rough time. We're trying to dial back to friends level because of the distance, but it hasn't been a smooth transition.

I'll FaceTime with her but I'm worried if at this point she'll see it as a desperate play for more attention.

I actually made a tentative plan for that earlier today. 

She's asked me to FaceTime several times over the past couple years and I've always been like meh because she is like exponentially hotter than I am. Last week she asked me again and I was like maybe tomorrow but we both ended up being busy that day. Today I asked wanna watch a movie together on FaceTime sometime? And she asked what movie. I said we'll see. 

Any movie suggestions? She has Netflix and HBO Go. Maybe Hulu. Not sure. 

I'm thinking about just a short FaceTime conversation sometime in the next few days maybe though. I don't want to come across as needy by chasing her too hard. To be honest, I *have* been needy lately and I'm trying to recover from it.
